# Device request handling

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 4 · Functional specifications

Parent page: [Functional specifications](section-4.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

<!-- codeforge:body:start (testo scrivibile: e' la sorgente pubblicata su Confluence) seed:47d14630ae816a73 -->
The central flow of the product: a citizen submits a public request, an administrator validates it and assigns volunteers, volunteers advance production through restricted status transitions, and the request ends with shipment and a follow-up with the family. Around this backbone the area covers administrative views and bulk operations, legacy data import, global messaging and email log monitoring, family consent and document emails, archiving, status-change notifications and per-request attachments and checklists. Public status and private status are kept separate so that the requester sees a simplified view. Status values and transitions are described in the reference pages of the status lifecycle concept; the area deliberately does not repeat them.
<!-- codeforge:body:end -->
